description: Compact pill displaying an active filter with field label and value. Supports remove and edit click callbacks.

parameters.name: OnRemove
parameters.description: Fires when the remove button is clicked.

parameters.name: OnEdit
parameters.description: Fires when the chip body is clicked (to re-open edit UI).

parameters.name: RemoveButtonId
parameters.description: Optional DOM id of the remove button. A host that removes a chip programmatically uses it to hand focus to the neighbouring chip's button, because the button that held focus leaves the DOM (WCAG 2.4.3). Null (the default) renders no id, leaving existing markup unchanged.
